# truenas_s3_access_key (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS S3 access key (s3.accesskey; TrueNAS 27.0 and later): an access key id and secret an account uses to sign S3 requests to the TrueNAS S3 service. The secret is either supplied write-only (`secret_wo`, never stored in state) or generated by TrueNAS and stored once in `secret` (Sensitive) from the create or rotate response; it is never read back from the API afterwards and is null after an import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A key whose secret TrueNAS generates. The secret is stored once, from the
# create response, as the Sensitive `secret` attribute; it is never read back.
resource "truenas_s3_access_key" "ci" {
  name           = "ci-state"
  username       = "svc_terraform" # a local user whose group holds SHARING_S3_WRITE
  manage_buckets = true            # may create buckets through the S3 protocol
  expires_at     = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

output "ci_access_key" {
  value = truenas_s3_access_key.ci.access_key
}

output "ci_secret" {
  value     = truenas_s3_access_key.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}

# A key whose access key id and secret come from the configuration. The
# secret is write-only: it never reaches state or a saved plan. Bumping
# secret_wo_version recreates the key with the new secret.
variable "backup_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "truenas_s3_access_key" "backup" {
  name              = "backup"
  username          = "svc_backup"
  access_key        = "BACKUPKEY0000000001"
  secret_wo         = var.backup_secret
  secret_wo_version = 1
}

# Rotate a generated secret by bumping rotate_version: the access key id is
# kept, `secret` gets the new value.
resource "truenas_s3_access_key" "rotated" {
  name           = "rotated"
  username       = "svc_terraform"
  rotate_version = 2
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the access key (1-200 characters).
- `username` (String) Account the access key belongs to. Create-only: changing it recreates the key.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_key` (String) Access key id clients sign requests with (16-128 upper-case letters and digits). Generated when unset. Create-only: changing it recreates the key.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the access key may be used; a disabled key is refused by the S3 service. Default true.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp after which the key expires; unset means never, and removing it makes an expiring key non-expiring again. Any offset or fractional-second spelling of the same instant matches the server's UTC read-back.
- `manage_buckets` (Boolean) Whether this key may create and delete buckets through the S3 protocol (needs a managed_root_dataset on truenas_s3_config and an account allowed to do so). Default false.
- `rotate_version` (Number) Bump to rotate: TrueNAS generates a new secret under the same access key id (s3.accesskey.update rotate) and the new value is stored in `secret`.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret access key to set (16-128 printable ASCII characters). Write-only: used at create, never stored in state. Requires `secret_wo_version`. Omit to have TrueNAS generate the secret (see `secret`).
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Version of `secret_wo`. Changing it recreates the key with the new secret (the API cannot set a chosen secret on an existing key; use `rotate_version` for a generated one). Required when secret_wo is set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC timestamp of creation.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the access key.
- `last_used_at` (String) RFC3339 UTC time the S3 service last accepted a request signed with this key; null when never used.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the key belongs to a local user account.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated secret access key, stored from the create or rotate response only (TrueNAS returns it to administrators on every read, but the provider never reads it back). Null when `secret_wo` supplied the secret, and after an import. Planned unknown when rotate_version changes.
- `status` (String) ENABLED, DISABLED or EXPIRED, as the S3 service sees the key.
- `user_identifier` (String) Stored account linkage: the numeric uid for a local account, a SID for a directory services one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric id (s3.accesskey.query). The secret is not imported.
terraform import truenas_s3_access_key.ci 7
```
